name: Agfa Vista 400
source: Agfa-Gevaert AG, Technical Data: Range of Agfa standard films, publication F-AF-E6 (2003-05), page 5

notes.characteristic: Colour density curves: daylight exposure 1/100 s, process AP 70/C-41, Status A or Status M densitometry (not specified per film); x is lg exposure (lx s). No reference exposure printed.
notes.sensitivity: Equi-energy spectrum, 0.5 above minimum density (colour negative films); y is lg sensitivity (relative). Line styles: dashed blue-sensitive, solid green-sensitive, dash-dot red-sensitive layer.
notes.dye_density: Absorption of the emulsion dyes: neutral object of medium brightness (medium density) and minimum density; no per-dye curves published.

grain.note: Granularity (x 1000): RMS 4.5; daylight exposure, visual filter (V lambda), diffuse density 1.0, 48 um scanning aperture.
